games.name: BuffNook Tower
games.title: BuffNook Tower · Free Physics Stacking Game
games.description: Stack 12 physics blocks on a seesaw. Survive 5 buffs. Decide when to bank. BuffNook Tower is a free browser game — desktop & mobile, no account required.

games.intro: Twelve blocks land on a tilted seesaw. Some blocks glue, some sink, some float, some slide. Bank your height at any point — but if you wait too long, the tower collapses and you lose everything. Play free, no account, no ads, saves in your browser.

howto.text: Q / E rotates the falling block 15°. Space drops it. L locks in after 3 blocks — half your height as the guaranteed score.
Click the left/right rotate buttons, tap the drop keycap, or drag directly on the canvas to aim. Everything works with just one hand.
Tap rotate, tap drop, tap bank. Mobile viewport shrinks the game area to 56vh so it stays visible above the control buttons. No scrolling, no pinching.

games.goal: Your daily official run is locked on your first completed drop of the day (UTC reset). Any later run is a practice score that does not overwrite the official result. Collapse gives you 40% of your final height; a successful bank gives you 50%. Progress is saved locally in localStorage — nothing leaves your browser.

tips.title: Wait a beat before aiming
tips.text: The seesaw sways for half a second after each block lands. Aim when the tower settles, not when it's still wobbling.

tips.title: Treat each buff as a question
tips.text: Glue sinks and stays — good for anchoring the base. Lead presses the beam down — park it on the light side. Float cancels lead exactly. Ice slides everything — land it last or not at all.

tips.title: Bank at your personal ceiling
tips.text: Most players collapse around the 280–340 cm mark. If your tower hits 280 and nothing obvious is wrong, bank it — the guaranteed 50% still beats collapsing to 40% of less.

faq.q: When does the daily challenge reset?
faq.a: BuffNook Tower resets every day at 00:00 UTC. New seed, new sequence, everyone in the world sees the same 12 blocks that day.

faq.q: Why is my score lower than the tower height?
faq.a: Height is measured on the seesaw in centimeters — collapse awards 40% of your final height, a successful bank awards 50%. Banking at 300 cm gives you a 150 cm score; collapsing at 300 cm gives you 120 cm.

faq.q: What is the difference between official and practice?
faq.a: Your first completed run each day is your official score — locked, archived, never overwritten. Every run after that is a practice run, saved separately for your own benchmarking.

faq.q: Is BuffNook Tower free to play?
faq.a: Yes. BuffNook Tower is completely free, no account required, no tracking, no ads. Progress saves only to your browser's localStorage under the key buffnook.tower.save. Clearing site data will reset it.

faq.q: Can I play on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Mobile view shrinks the game canvas to 56vh, enlarges the rotate/drop/lock buttons, and keeps every action reachable with one hand. Works on iOS Safari and Chrome on Android.
